## IP Rating Explained

**IP (Ingress Protection) Rating Format: IPXY**

- **X (First Digit - Dust Protection)**: 0-6
  - 0: No protection
  - 1: Protected against solid objects >50mm
  - 2: Protected against solid objects >12.5mm
  - 3: Protected against solid objects >2.5mm
  - 4: Protected against solid objects >1mm
  - 5: Limited dust ingress (no harmful deposit)
  - 6: Totally protected against dust

- **Y (Second Digit - Water Protection)**: 0-8
  - 0: No protection
  - 1: Dripping water (vertical)
  - 2: Dripping water (up to 15°)
  - 3: Spraying water (up to 60°)
  - 4: Splashing water from all directions
  - 5: Water jets from all directions
  - 6: Powerful water jets
  - 7: Immersion up to 1m for up to 30 minutes
  - 8: Prolonged immersion under pressure

## NEMA vs IEC Standards

- **NEMA (National Electrical Manufacturers Association)**: Primarily used in North America
- **IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission)**: International standard (IP ratings)

NEMA types provide practical descriptions, while IEC IP ratings provide more specific technical classifications.
